definitions.gloss: to get an upset stomach; to have stomach trouble
definitions.explanation: To upset one's digestion, usually from eating or drinking something bad, too much, or too cold. It is the everyday, slightly euphemistic way to mention diarrhea or stomach pain.

examples.japanese: お{腹|なか}を{壊|こわ}した。
⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}みすぎ→飲みすぎ：22059_nomisugi⟧てお{腹|なか}を{壊|こわ}した。
examples.english: I drank too many cold things and upset my stomach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行先|りょこうさき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{生水|なまみず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧、お{腹|なか}を{壊|こわ}してしまった。
examples.english: I drank tap water on my trip and ended up with an upset stomach.

notes:
Said of oneself or of others, including children. The past form お{腹|なか}を{壊|こわ}した is the usual way to explain why one is unwell or absent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|た}べすぎてお{腹|なか}を{壊|こわ}す: to upset one's stomach by overeating
- お{腹|なか}を{壊|こわ}しやすい: to have a delicate stomach
- お{腹|なか}を{壊|こわ}して⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧: to stay home from school with a stomach upset
